name: postwire
description: Publish and schedule social media posts from Claude Code: TikTok and YouTube video uploads, Instagram posts and Reels, LinkedIn, Facebook Pages, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord and more, through PostWire's hosted MCP server (OAuth sign-in, no developer apps to register). Includes skills for crossposting, a weekly content calendar, bulk scheduling and per-network posting.
